question: What is the total area of the rooms on level L4?

question: Which level has the most rooms?

question: How many rooms have a polished concrete/LVT floor finish?

question: How many rooms list Retail as their occupant?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Room AS r JOIN Element AS re ON r.Element = re._key JOIN Parameter AS p ON p.Element = r.Element JOIN ParameterDescriptor AS pd ON p.ParameterDescriptor = pd._key WHERE pd.Name = 'Occupant' AND p.Value = 'Retail' AND (re.DesignOption IS NULL OR re.DesignOption IN (SELECT _key FROM DesignOption WHERE IsPrimary = 1))

gold_sql: SELECT SUM(a.Value) FROM Area AS a JOIN AreaScheme AS s ON a.AreaScheme = s._key JOIN Element AS se ON s.Element = se._key WHERE se.Name = 'Gross Building'

question: How many sheets are in the 'Arch - Schematic Design' sheet set?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ViewSheetInViewSheetSet AS x JOIN ViewSheetSet AS s ON x.ViewSheetSet = s._key JOIN Element AS se ON s.Element = se._key WHERE se.Name = 'Arch - Schematic Design'

question: How many elements contain the material 'Gypsum Wall Board'?

question: How many doors are placed on level L4?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FamilyInstance AS fi JOIN Element AS e ON fi.Element = e._key JOIN Category AS c ON e.Category = c._key JOIN Level AS l ON e.Level = l._key JOIN Element AS le ON l.Element = le._key WHERE c.Name = 'Doors' AND le.Name = 'L4'

question: Which level has the most doors placed on it?
gold_sql: SELECT le.Name FROM FamilyInstance AS fi JOIN Element AS e ON fi.Element = e._key JOIN Category AS c ON e.Category = c._key JOIN Level AS l ON e.Level = l._key JOIN Element AS le ON l.Element = le._key WHERE c.Name = 'Doors' GROUP BY le.Name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which door types have a fire rating of 90 minutes?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT te.Name FROM FamilyType AS ft JOIN Element AS te ON ft.Element = te._key JOIN Category AS c ON te.Category = c._key JOIN Parameter AS p ON p.Element = te._key JOIN ParameterDescriptor AS pd ON p.ParameterDescriptor = pd._key WHERE pd.Name = 'Fire Rating' AND c.Name = 'Doors' AND p.Value IN ('90 MIN', '1.5 HR', '1 1/2 HR')

question: How many wall types have a 2-hour fire rating?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT te.Name) FROM FamilyType AS ft JOIN Element AS te ON ft.Element = te._key JOIN Category AS c ON te.Category = c._key JOIN Parameter AS p ON p.Element = te._key JOIN ParameterDescriptor AS pd ON p.ParameterDescriptor = pd._key WHERE pd.Name = 'Fire Rating' AND c.Name = 'Walls' AND p.Value IN ('2 HR', '120 MIN')

question: How many doors are installed whose door type has a 90-minute fire rating?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FamilyInstance AS fi JOIN FamilyType AS ft ON fi.FamilyType = ft._key JOIN Element AS te ON ft.Element = te._key JOIN Category AS c ON te.Category = c._key JOIN Parameter AS p ON p.Element = te._key JOIN ParameterDescriptor AS pd ON p.ParameterDescriptor = pd._key WHERE c.Name = 'Doors' AND pd.Name = 'Fire Rating' AND p.Value IN ('90 MIN', '1.5 HR', '1 1/2 HR')

question: What is the total length of all pipes in the model?

question: What is the name of sheet A101?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT pname.Value FROM ViewSheet AS vs JOIN Parameter AS pnum ON pnum.Element = vs.Element JOIN ParameterDescriptor AS dnum ON pnum.ParameterDescriptor = dnum._key JOIN Parameter AS pname ON pname.Element = vs.Element JOIN ParameterDescriptor AS dname ON pname.ParameterDescriptor = dname._key WHERE dnum.Name = 'Sheet Number' AND pnum.Value = 'A101' AND dname.Name = 'Sheet Name'

question: Which structural material is assigned to the most structural elements (ignoring blank and '<By Category>' values)?
gold_sql: SELECT p.DisplayValue FROM Parameter AS p JOIN ParameterDescriptor AS pd ON p.ParameterDescriptor = pd._key WHERE pd.Name = 'Structural Material' AND p.DisplayValue NOT IN ('', '<By Category>') GROUP BY p.DisplayValue ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: On which level is room 301 located?

question: How many family types are fire rated?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ft._key) FROM FamilyType AS ft JOIN Parameter AS p ON p.Element = ft.Element JOIN ParameterDescriptor AS pd ON p.ParameterDescriptor = pd._key WHERE pd.Name = 'Fire Rating' AND p.Value NOT IN ('', 'NR')

question: How many plumbing fixtures are placed on level L4?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FamilyInstance AS fi JOIN Element AS e ON fi.Element = e._key JOIN Category AS c ON e.Category = c._key JOIN Level AS l ON e.Level = l._key JOIN Element AS le ON l.Element = le._key WHERE c.Name = 'Plumbing Fixtures' AND le.Name = 'L4'

question: How many lighting fixtures are placed on level L3 in the electrical model?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FamilyInstance AS fi JOIN Element AS e ON fi.Element = e._key JOIN Category AS c ON e.Category = c._key JOIN Level AS l ON e.Level = l._key JOIN Element AS le ON l.Element = le._key JOIN BimDocument AS b ON e.BimDocument = b._key WHERE c.Name = 'Lighting Fixtures' AND le.Name = 'L3' AND b.Title = 'Snowdon Towers Sample Electrical'

question: How many wall types have more than five layers?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FamilyType AS ft JOIN Element AS te ON ft.Element = te._key JOIN Category AS c ON te.Category = c._key JOIN CompoundStructure AS cs ON ft.CompoundStructure = cs._key WHERE c.Name = 'Walls' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CompoundStructureLayer AS csl WHERE csl.CompoundStructure = cs._key) > 5

question: How thick is the 'Solar Wall (L5)' wall type, in inches?
gold_sql: SELECT cs.Width * 12 FROM FamilyType AS ft JOIN Element AS te ON ft.Element = te._key JOIN CompoundStructure AS cs ON ft.CompoundStructure = cs._key WHERE te.Name = 'Solar Wall (L5)'

question: Which wall type is the thickest?
gold_sql: SELECT te.Name FROM FamilyType AS ft JOIN Element AS te ON ft.Element = te._key JOIN Category AS c ON te.Category = c._key JOIN CompoundStructure AS cs ON ft.CompoundStructure = cs._key WHERE c.Name = 'Walls' ORDER BY cs.Width DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many elements in the structural model are affected by warnings?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ew.Element) FROM ElementInWarning AS ew JOIN Element AS e ON ew.Element = e._key JOIN BimDocument AS b ON e.BimDocument = b._key WHERE b.Title = 'Snowdon Towers Sample Structural'

question: What is the total area of rooms with a 'Residential One Story' occupancy?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(r.Area) FROM Room AS r JOIN Element AS re ON r.Element = re._key JOIN Parameter AS p ON p.Element = r.Element JOIN ParameterDescriptor AS pd ON p.ParameterDescriptor = pd._key WHERE pd.Name = 'Occupancy' AND p.Value = 'Residential One Story' AND (re.DesignOption IS NULL OR re.DesignOption IN (SELECT _key FROM DesignOption WHERE IsPrimary = 1))

question: Which occupant type has the largest total room area?
gold_sql: SELECT p.Value FROM Room AS r JOIN Element AS re ON r.Element = re._key JOIN Parameter AS p ON p.Element = r.Element JOIN ParameterDescriptor AS pd ON p.ParameterDescriptor = pd._key WHERE pd.Name = 'Occupant' AND p.Value <> '' AND (re.DesignOption IS NULL OR re.DesignOption IN (SELECT _key FROM DesignOption WHERE IsPrimary = 1)) GROUP BY p.Value ORDER BY SUM(r.Area) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many pipe fittings belong to the 'Domestic Cold Water 1' system?

question: What is the total length of all ducts in the model?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CAST(p.Value AS REAL)) FROM Parameter AS p JOIN ParameterDescriptor AS pd ON p.ParameterDescriptor = pd._key JOIN Element AS e ON p.Element = e._key JOIN Category AS c ON e.Category = c._key WHERE pd.Name = 'Length' AND c.Name = 'Ducts'

question: How many rooms on level L3 have a painted wall finish?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Room AS r JOIN Element AS re ON r.Element = re._key JOIN Level AS l ON re.Level = l._key JOIN Element AS le ON l.Element = le._key JOIN Parameter AS p ON p.Element = r.Element JOIN ParameterDescriptor AS pd ON p.ParameterDescriptor = pd._key WHERE le.Name = 'L3' AND pd.Name = 'Wall Finish' AND p.Value = 'Paint' AND (re.DesignOption IS NULL OR re.DesignOption IN (SELECT _key FROM DesignOption WHERE IsPrimary = 1))

question: What is the name of the largest room on level L4?
gold_sql: SELECT re.Name FROM Room AS r JOIN Element AS re ON r.Element = re._key JOIN Level AS l ON re.Level = l._key JOIN Element AS le ON l.Element = le._key WHERE le.Name = 'L4' AND (re.DesignOption IS NULL OR re.DesignOption IN (SELECT _key FROM DesignOption WHERE IsPrimary = 1)) ORDER BY r.Area DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many door and wall types have a 1-hour fire rating?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT te._key) FROM FamilyType AS ft JOIN Element AS te ON ft.Element = te._key JOIN Category AS c ON te.Category = c._key JOIN Parameter AS p ON p.Element = te._key JOIN ParameterDescriptor AS pd ON p.ParameterDescriptor = pd._key WHERE pd.Name = 'Fire Rating' AND c.Name IN ('Doors', 'Walls') AND p.Value IN ('1 HR', '60 MIN', '1 HR Smoke')
